# Wheel plan {#sec-dd-wheelplan}


::: {.cell}

:::


## Overview

The wheel plan is the DVLA's description of a vehicle's axles and wheels,
such as `2 AXLE RIGID BODY` or `2 WHEEL`. It separates, for example, rigid
lorries from articulated ones, and two-wheeled from three-wheeled motorcycles
(@sec-vehicle-types).

- **`wheelplan`** is the harmonised wheel plan: the DVLA value where the VES
  record describes this vehicle, and otherwise the most common value among
  similar vehicles with the same test class, else among similar vehicles. A
  borrowed wheel plan that contradicts the test class or type approval is
  never used; `wheelplan_src` is then `conflict`.
- **`wheelplan_src`** says which (`dvla`, `variant` or `model_year_fuel`).
- **`wheelplan_DVLA`** is the value as supplied.

The backfill is described in the methodology,
[section 5.6](../../reports/methodology.md#other-attributes).

|:----------------|:----------|:-------|:-------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:-------|
|`wheelplan`      |Yes        |VARCHAR |pipeline      |Wheel plan: DVLA (same vehicle only), else the most common wheel plan of similar vehicles with the same test class, else of similar vehicles; never one that contradicts the test class or type approval (wheelplan_src conflict) |0.54%   |
|`wheelplan_src`  |No         |VARCHAR |pipeline      |Source of the matching harmonised column: dvsa or dvla (recorded), variant (same make/model/birth year/fuel/engine size) or model_year_fuel (same make/model/birth year/fuel)                                                     |0.54%   |

## Coverage

The DVLA wheel plan is present wherever a VES record was found,
77% of vehicles (@sec-dd-dvla-status). Because
the wheel plan of similar vehicles is almost always known, the backfill makes
`wheelplan` nearly complete at every age: 99.5%
of vehicles (@fig-dd-wheelplan).


::: {#tbl-dd-wheelplan-coverage .cell layout-align="center" tbl-cap='Share of vehicles with a value, by year of first use.'}
::: {.cell-output-display}


|Column           | All vehicles| Before 2000| 2000–09| 2010–19| 2020 on|
|:----------------|------------:|-----------:|-------:|-------:|-------:|
|`wheelplan`      |        99.5%|       99.7%|   99.5%|   99.7%|   98.7%|
|`wheelplan_src`  |        99.5%|       99.7%|   99.5%|   99.7%|   98.7%|
|`wheelplan_DVLA` |        77.0%|       61.9%|   64.8%|   96.3%|   82.0%|

## Values

How the values of each column change over time, by year of first use, from
1990. Each chart shows the share of vehicles with each value, with the less
common values grouped as *All other values* and missing values as *Blank*.


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

### `wheelplan`

Wheel plan: DVLA (same vehicle only), else the most common wheel plan of similar vehicles with the same test class, else of similar vehicles; never one that contradicts the test class or type approval (wheelplan_src conflict).
